info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Tracking API enables users to monitor the status and location of shipments in real time. This API provides essential information about current and historical tracking details, ensuring businesses can efficiently manage their logistics operations. Typical consumers include logistics managers and supply chain professionals who rely on timely information to coordinate delivery processes. By leveraging this API, users can enhance transparency and improve customer satisfaction through accurate shipment updates.

get.description: Retrieve the current status and details of specified shipments using their tracking identifiers. This operation allows users to monitor the progress of their shipments in real-time.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking shipments. This payload must provide the necessary details to retrieve the current status of a shipment.

200.description: The request was successful, and tracking information is returned.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for tracking shipments via the GET operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: An informational message regarding the tracking operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the GET operation on shipment tracking.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information associated with the shipment tracking.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This value helps clients understand the performance of the API call.
